title: Get help now
heading: Get help now
lede: Work down the page in order. Your ticks stay in this tab and nowhere else.

safety.heading: Make the car safe
safety.done: That is as safe as you can make it. Now get help.

emergency: If anyone is hurt or you are in danger, call your local emergency number first (911 in the US and Canada, 112 in the EU).

call.heading: Find help nearby
call.locationNote: Note where you are before you call: a road name, a mile marker or the nearest exit.

sheet.heading: What to tell them
sheet.body: Read this out when you call a tow operator or a mechanic.
sheet.problemPlaceholder: For example, flat tire or will not start
sheet.empty: Add your vehicle and say what happened, and your summary appears here.
sheet.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

notSure.heading: Not sure what is wrong?
notSure.body: Answer two questions and get the most likely cause.
